description: The enumeration of possible upload types.
name: UploadType

enum.name: S3
enum.description: An upload to an Amazon Web Services S3 bucket

enum.name: GOOGLECLOUDSTORAGE
enum.description: An upload to a Google Cloud Platform storage bucket

enum.name: SFTP
enum.description: An upload using the Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP).

enum.name: HTTPS
enum.description: An upload using the HTTPS protocol.

enum.name: PROXYLOCAL
enum.description: An upload using a local proxy service.

enum.name: NONE
enum.description: No upload type, for when the upload type is unknown or unspecified
